verdict.rationale: Unreal documents extensive command-line tooling for headless CI use: UnrealEditor-Cmd/UAT command-line cooking, packaging, and deployment (unreal-docs-16, unreal-docs-17, unreal-docs-36), the Unreal Automation Tool explicitly for automating builds and tests (unreal-docs-30), and general command-line arguments for running the engine without the editor UI (unreal-docs-7, unreal-docs-14, unreal-docs-32). These are official, well-documented first-party mechanisms widely used in production CI pipelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a full CI pipeline working end-to-end, and no evidence pack citation of an official CI/CD template or GitHub Actions integration.
